root_cause.text: In `ice_set_ringparam()`, the temporary `tx_rings` were left with `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` set after `tstamp_ring` was explicitly nulled, creating inconsistent TX timestamp state so the error-path cleanup treated the ring as TxTime-enabled and dereferenced the NULL `tstamp_ring`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags);` immediately after `tx_rings[i].tstamp_ring = NULL;`, and the CVE/commit message states the unwind path `ice_clean_tx_ring() -> ice_free_tx_tstamp_ring() -> ice_free_tstamp_ring() -> tstamp_ring->desc` can NULL-deref because `ice_is_txtime_cfg()` remains true when the flag is not cleared.

intent_record.intent_summary: Clear the TXTIME flag when reinitializing TX rings so resized rings do not inherit stale TX scheduling state.
intent_record.what: A call to clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags) was added in the TX ring reinitialization loop before assigning tx_tstamps and calling ice_setup_tx_ring(&tx_rings[i]).
intent_record.how: This ensures the TXTIME flag is explicitly cleared on each recreated TX ring during ring parameter changes, preventing the ring from being set up with stale TXTIME state from prior configuration and avoiding incorrect transmit scheduling behavior.
